subject.title: [Feature]: Make detached longwork final delivery ownership explicit

question: Should this issue remain the canonical design thread for a durable final-delivery ownership contract, and if so should the owner live in subagent registry delivery state, the existing task ledger/outbox substrate, or another existing delivery substrate?
rationale: Current main has adjacent requester routing and pending-final state, but the requested explicit owner-mode contract remains a product/API choice after the broad implementation PR closed unmerged.

options.title: Keep This As Canonical
options.body: Use this issue to choose the owner substrate and require a smaller follow-up PR with live or targeted delivery proof.

options.title: Move To Narrower Canonical
options.body: Open or name a narrower issue for the final-delivery obligation invariant, then supersede this issue to that thread.

options.title: Reject First-Class Owner Modes
options.body: Document that current requester-routing plus integration-owned bridge behavior is the intended boundary and leave dual-surface delivery to custom integrations.

recommendation.title: Keep This As Canonical
recommendation.body: Use this issue to choose the owner substrate and require a smaller follow-up PR with live or targeted delivery proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is API/product direction across adjacent gateway, plugin-runtime, and subagent delivery work where this person has recent routing history and was subscribed to this issue.
